_doc: The line above the focus orb on the home screen. One is picked each time you come home: a greeting for the time of day, or a line from 'anytime'. '{name}' becomes the player's name; lines with it are skipped until they've set one. Original lines, so there's nothing to misattribute.
morning: Early start? Your pet's already up.
A quiet morning is a gift. Use it well.
afternoon: Halfway through the day. Keep the pace.
Afternoon walks are the best walks.
evening: One more stretch before you rest?
The day's nearly done. Finish it well.
Wind down with one calm session.
night: Don't forget to sleep after this one.
The stars are out. So are you.
